amharic.text: ቤታችን ለእኛ የመኖሪያ ቦታ ብቻ አይደለም። የፍቅራችን፣ የትዝታችንና የአንድነታችን መገኛ ነው።

english.text: Our home is more than a place to live. It is where our love, memories, and unity belong.

amharic.text: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ፍቅር የሚገለጸው በታላላቅ ቃላት ሳይሆን፣ በእንዲህ ባሉ ትናንሽ እንክብካቤዎች ነው።

english.text: Sometimes love is expressed not through grand words, but through these quiet, tender gestures.

comparison.syllabic_density_note: Amharic Ge'ez script produces longer vocalization duration due to morphological agglutination and deliberate elder pacing.

amharic.text: ምክንያቱም ቤተሰብ ማለት አብሮ መኖር ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ አብሮ መኖርን ትርጉም የሚሰጥ ፍቅር ነው።

english.text: Because family is not simply living together; it is the love that gives meaning to being together.
